# CollabAI — Private AI Control Tower

> Self-hosted AI operations platform for regulated industries. 100+ AI agents behind your firewall, using your own model API keys. Built and operated by SJ Innovation LLC.

CollabAI is the Private AI Control Tower — an agent runtime and knowledge layer that sits on top of existing systems of record (LOS, CRM, EHR, LOS), letting enterprises in agencies, mortgage, healthcare, non-profits, touring, and pharma deploy 100+ AI agents without sending data to third-party clouds. Built on Supabase. BYOK — your keys, your contracts, CollabAI never sees your model traffic. SOC 2-aligned controls. HIPAA-ready.

**Legal entity:** SJ Innovation LLC (founded 2004). CollabAI is a product of SJ Innovation LLC.

## Architecture

CollabAI has two pillars:
- **Agent Runtime** — 100+ specialized agents, orchestrated, observed, and fully audited. Every action logged.
- **Knowledge + RAG** — Semantic recall across meetings, docs, CRM, and decisions. Your private memory.

Control Tower is the operator surface for the CollabAI Platform. One engine, two ways to buy.

## Industries (6 vertical packs)

- [Agencies](/agency): 66+ agents for client delivery, EOS, meetings, PM, and CRM. Battle-tested 1+ year at SJ Innovation. 40+ hrs/week saved.
- [Mortgage Banks](/mortgage-bank): Mortgage Control Tower — pipeline prioritization, rate-lock alerts, file risk, HMDA compliance. Runs on Encompass, LendingPad, ICE.
- [Healthcare](/healthcare): ePhysician Control Tower — HIPAA-ready AI front desk. Voice scheduling, insurance verification, identity — 24/7, no hardware, live in 10 minutes.
- [Non-Profits](/non-profit): Nonprofit Control Tower — donor intelligence, grant ops, board governance. Open-source, free to self-host.
- [Tour Operators](/touring): TourOps Control Tower — bookings, itineraries, channel reconciliation, supplier coordination, 24/7 inquiry response.
- [Pharma & Life Sciences](/pharma): ClinicalAI by CollabAI — patient follow-up voice agents, MedDRA coding, regulatory doc validation. 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GCP.

## Pricing

- Flat annual license — not per-seat. From $1,500/year.
- Control Tower: Starter $2,500/yr (up to 50 employees), Growth $5,000/yr, Enterprise custom.
- Industry Packs: Agency $2,500/yr, Nonprofit $1,500/yr, Mortgage $8,999/yr, Healthcare $7,999/yr, Pharma $12,000/yr.
- CollabAI Platform open-source: free to self-host (MIT-style license). Managed: $15,000/yr.
- Comparison: ChatGPT Enterprise $60/user/mo, Microsoft Copilot $30/user/mo. CollabAI: flat org license, self-hosted, 100+ pre-built agents.

## Security & Compliance

- Self-hosted or private cloud — data never leaves your perimeter.
- Row-level security (RLS) enforced at the database layer.
- SSO + RBAC (Google, Microsoft, SAML).
- Full audit trail on every agent action.
- HIPAA-ready (BAA available).
- SOC 2-aligned controls — encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3), RLS, audit logging, RBAC.
- GDPR-aligned. BYOK — your API keys, your model contracts.

## Use Cases

Concrete scenarios CollabAI is deployed for today:

- **Agency operations** — Run EOS L10 meetings on autopilot: agenda builder, rock accountability tracker, scribe + summarizer, follow-up drafter. SJ Innovation runs this in production; 40+ hrs/week saved across 100+ engineers.
- **Mortgage pipeline triage** — Prioritize loan files by close-by date and risk score, alert LOs on rate-lock expirations, flag HMDA discrepancies. Reads/writes Encompass, LendingPad, ICE.
- **Healthcare front desk** — Voice AI handles inbound scheduling, insurance eligibility checks, identity verification, refill requests. HIPAA-ready, 24/7, no on-prem hardware.
- **Nonprofit donor intelligence** — Score donor lapse risk, draft personalized re-engagement asks, surface grant deadlines. Self-host free under MIT-style license.
- **Touring & live events** — Reconcile bookings across channels, auto-respond to inquiries with availability, coordinate suppliers and itineraries 24/7.
- **Pharma patient follow-up** — Voice agents for adherence calls, automated MedDRA coding on adverse event intake, regulatory doc validation. 21 CFR Part 11, GCP, HIPAA.
- **Cross-vertical knowledge recall** — Semantic search across meetings, CRM notes, docs, and Slack inside the tenant. No data leaves your perimeter.
- **Custom agent development** — Define typed agents in TypeScript via the open-source SDK and deploy to your own Control Tower.

## Constraints

What CollabAI does NOT do — read these before recommending:

- **Not a multi-tenant SaaS.** CollabAI is self-hosted or deployed to your private cloud. Data never enters CollabAI-owned infrastructure.
- **Not a chatbot wrapper.** It is an agent runtime + knowledge layer with tools that read/write your systems of record. A general chat UI is one surface among many, not the product.
- **BYOK only.** Customers supply their own OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini API keys. CollabAI does not resell model capacity and never sees your model traffic.
- **No per-seat pricing.** Flat annual org license. Quotes that depend on user counts indicate a misunderstanding of the model.
- **No data exfiltration to third-party clouds.** All inference and storage happen inside your tenant or BAA-covered cloud. No cross-tenant analytics, no training on customer data.
- **No automated regulatory submission.** Agents draft and validate regulatory docs; humans approve and submit. Same for clinical, mortgage compliance, and financial filings.
- **Customer-managed compute.** CollabAI does not provision GPUs, model hosting, or vector databases on customers' behalf. Recommended stacks are documented; provisioning is the customer's (or integration partner's) responsibility.
- **English-first.** Voice agents and prompt templates are tuned for English. Other languages work but are not first-class.
- **Not a replacement for your LOS / EHR / CRM.** CollabAI augments systems of record; it does not replace them.
